_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Deja Vu#000.src: Whatever that odd feeling was, it's over now. And there's Asher's shovel! Better return this to him.
Deja Vu#000.dst: 그 이상한 느낌이 뭐였든 이제 끝났다. 그리고 저기 Asher의 삽이 있다! 돌려주는 게 좋겠다.

Deja Vu#002.src: Whenever you're ready to save Asher, step through the rift.
Deja Vu#002.dst: Asher를 구할 준비가 되면 균열을 지나가게.

Deja Vu#005.src: Well well well, look who decided to come back with their tail between their legs.
Deja Vu#005.dst: 이런이런, 꼬리 내리고 돌아온 게 누군지 좀 봐.
Deja Vu#005.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#006.src: Two weeks now and you still haven't found it? Ugh, I can't believe I ever trusted you with such a simple task.
Deja Vu#006.dst: 2주나 지났는데 아직도 못 찾았어? 하, 이런 간단한 일을 너한테 맡겼다니.
Deja Vu#006.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#007.src: Who am I? WHAT DO YOU MEAN WHO AM I? You offered to help find my shovel, and I've been waiting two weeks!
Deja Vu#007.dst: 내가 누구냐고? 그게 무슨 소리야? 내 삽 찾아 준다며! 2주나 기다렸다고!
Deja Vu#007.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#008.src: Forget about your payment. Unless you either pay me back or get my shovel right now!
Deja Vu#008.dst: 보수는 잊어. 당장 돈을 물어내든지 내 삽을 찾아오든지 해!
Deja Vu#008.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#009.src: My shovel? That's why I sent you out in the first place! It's somewhere in {p}. I lost it while following a trail of flowers.
Deja Vu#009.dst: 내 삽? 그것 때문에 보낸 거잖아! {p} 어딘가에 있어. 꽃길을 따라가다 잃어버렸어.
Deja Vu#009.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#010.src: I think it was south west of the large ruined gate. Now go get it!
Deja Vu#010.dst: 커다란 폐허 관문 남서쪽이었던 것 같아. 얼른 찾아와!
Deja Vu#010.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#013.src: Well hello there, stranger! Welcome to {p}! Always nice to see a new face around here.
Deja Vu#013.dst: 어이, 낯선 사람! {p}에 온 걸 환영해! 새 얼굴은 언제 봐도 반갑다니까.
Deja Vu#013.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#014.src: Mad at you? Why would I be mad at you? We've never met.
Deja Vu#014.dst: 화났냐고? 내가 왜 화를 내? 우린 처음 보는데.
Deja Vu#014.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#015.src: I know this a bit forward, but I need to ask for your help with-
Deja Vu#015.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#016.src: Wait, is that-? It is! You've found my shovel! I recognize those markings anywhere.
Deja Vu#016.dst: 잠깐, 그거-? 맞아! 내 삽을 찾았구나! 저 무늬는 어디서든 알아보지.
Deja Vu#016.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#017.src: But why is it so rusty? Ah, no matter. Give that to me and I'll head inside to get you a nice reward.
Deja Vu#017.dst: 근데 왜 이렇게 녹슬었지? 뭐, 상관없어. 이리 줘, 안에서 보상 가져올게.
Deja Vu#017.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#018.src: Thank you. Now, about that reward-
Deja Vu#018.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#020.src: Oh dear, there he goes again. Poor fool ignored my warnings and touched that shovel.
Deja Vu#020.dst: 이런, 또 저러는군. 가엾은 녀석, 내 경고를 무시하고 그 삽을 만졌어.
Deja Vu#020.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#021.src: He's gone and got himself stuck in a loop.
Deja Vu#021.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#022.src: Head inside, soldier, and I'll explain what's happening here.
Deja Vu#022.dst: 안으로 들어오게, 병사. 무슨 일인지 설명해 주지.
Deja Vu#022.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#024.src: Without Asher, his house has vanished from time.
Deja Vu#024.dst: Asher가 없으니 그의 집도 시간 속에서 사라졌네.
Deja Vu#024.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#026.src: Let me explain why Asher disappeared...
Deja Vu#026.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#027.src: {p} was built many years ago by a long-lost civilization.
Deja Vu#027.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#028.src: They had odd powers. They ended up distorting time itself.
Deja Vu#028.dst: 그들은 기이한 힘을 지녔고, 결국 시간 자체를 비틀었지.
Deja Vu#028.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#029.src: The tools they used to make these structures are imbued with their power.
Deja Vu#029.dst: 이 건축물을 지을 때 쓴 도구엔 그들의 힘이 깃들어 있네.
Deja Vu#029.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#030.src: Asher found one of these tools: the shovel.
Deja Vu#030.dst: Asher가 그 도구 중 하나를 찾았지. 바로 그 삽일세.
Deja Vu#030.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#031.src: The shovel is tethering its time of influence to today. It keeps sending Asher back.
Deja Vu#031.dst: 삽이 자기 영향이 미치는 시간을 오늘에 묶어 두고 있어. 그래서 Asher를 계속 되돌려 보내지.
Deja Vu#031.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#032.src: The issue is, Asher died in the past. This creates a paradox.
Deja Vu#032.dst: 문제는 Asher가 과거에 죽었다는 걸세. 그래서 역설이 생기지.
Deja Vu#032.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#033.src: We can save him if I send you back to prevent his death. Go through this rift to join him in the past.
Deja Vu#033.dst: 자네를 과거로 보내 그의 죽음을 막으면 구할 수 있네. 이 균열을 지나 과거의 그에게 가게.
Deja Vu#033.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#034.src: Find a way to save Asher from his death.

Deja Vu#036.src: Usually this place is filled with workers.
Deja Vu#036.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#037.src: But no one's here. And this place is clearly not done.
Deja Vu#037.dst: 근데 아무도 없네. 게다가 여긴 딱 봐도 미완성이야.
Deja Vu#037.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#038.src: Whatever the case, I should probably find my shovel.
Deja Vu#038.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#039.src: If I were a shovel, where would I be?
Deja Vu#039.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#041.src: This place... There's so much going on but no one here.
Deja Vu#041.dst: 여긴... 온갖 게 돌아가는데 사람이 없어.
Deja Vu#041.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#042.src: What I don't understand, though, is why this place looks brand new.
Deja Vu#042.dst: 근데 이해가 안 되는 건, 여기가 왜 새것처럼 보이냐는 거야.
Deja Vu#042.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#043.src: This place looks like it's just being built!
Deja Vu#043.dst: 꼭 지금 짓고 있는 곳 같잖아!
Deja Vu#043.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#044.src: This must be something to do with the valley's magic. Wouldn't be the first time.
Deja Vu#044.dst: 분명 골짜기의 마법과 관련이 있을 거야. 처음 있는 일도 아니고.
Deja Vu#044.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#046.src: In fact, whenever I hold that shovel, this kind of stuff seems to happen.
Deja Vu#046.dst: 사실 그 삽만 쥐면 꼭 이런 일이 생기는 것 같단 말이야.
Deja Vu#046.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#047.src: Maybe it's sent me way back. Back to the construction of this place.
Deja Vu#047.dst: 어쩌면 한참 전으로 보내진 걸지도. 여길 짓던 시절로.
Deja Vu#047.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#048.src: Then why is no one here?
Deja Vu#048.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#049.src: Woah, that tree looks like it might fall over!
Deja Vu#049.dst: 우와, 저 나무 곧 쓰러질 것 같아!
Deja Vu#049.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#051.src: Uhf! How do they have a cannon? These guys must be super advanced.
Deja Vu#051.dst: 윽! 대포가 있다고? 이 사람들 엄청 발전했나 봐.
Deja Vu#051.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#052.src: I think I'm close now. I can just feel that shovel close by.
Deja Vu#052.dst: 거의 다 온 것 같아. 삽이 가까이 있는 게 느껴져.
Deja Vu#052.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#054.src: My my, a crushing defeat to be sure. You'll have to find a way to stop that.
Deja Vu#054.dst: 저런, 아주 납작하게 깨졌구먼. 그걸 막을 방법을 찾아야겠네.
Deja Vu#054.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#055.src: Go back through the rift and make sure Asher doesn't become a pancake this time.
Deja Vu#055.dst: 균열을 지나 돌아가서, 이번엔 Asher가 납작해지지 않게 하게.
Deja Vu#055.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#057.src: Well that was quite the explosive end to our friend there. There must be a way to prevent that.
Deja Vu#057.dst: 우리 친구가 아주 폭발적인 최후를 맞았구먼. 막을 방법이 있을 걸세.
Deja Vu#057.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#058.src: Head back in there. This time with less explosions.
Deja Vu#058.dst: 다시 가 보게. 이번엔 폭발은 좀 줄이고.
Deja Vu#058.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#059.src: Oh, so close on that try. Who could've guessed that was how our friend met his end?
Deja Vu#059.dst: 아, 이번엔 아깝구먼. 우리 친구가 그렇게 최후를 맞을 줄 누가 알았겠나?
Deja Vu#059.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#060.src: I'm sure you'll nail it this time. Not sure how you will stop a cosmic event, though.
Deja Vu#060.dst: 이번엔 분명 해낼 걸세. 다만 우주적 사건을 어떻게 막을지는 모르겠군.
Deja Vu#060.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#061.src: Oh there it is! My shovel!
Deja Vu#061.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#062.src: I'm surprised it took me back this far this time.
Deja Vu#062.dst: 이번엔 이렇게 멀리까지 보내질 줄은 몰랐네.
Deja Vu#062.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#063.src: Well, time to head on back-
Deja Vu#063.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#066.src: Asher, you remember when I allowed you to live in the valley, I told you not to touch any odd objects.
Deja Vu#066.dst: Asher, 골짜기에 살게 해 줄 때 이상한 물건은 만지지 말라고 했던 거 기억하나?
Deja Vu#066.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#068.src: You got yourself stuck hundreds of years ago. If it wasn't for this guard, you'd be removed from existence.
Deja Vu#068.dst: 자넨 수백 년 전에 갇혀 버렸네. 이 경비병이 아니었으면 존재 자체가 지워졌을 걸세.
Deja Vu#068.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#069.src: Oh... So that's where I am. I am so sorry Martyn. Please don't kick me out of the valley.
Deja Vu#069.dst: 아... 그래서 여기 있는 거군요. 정말 죄송해요, Martyn. 골짜기에서 쫓아내지 마세요.
Deja Vu#069.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#070.src: I know time travel can be tempting. But it's far more dangerous than you can ever understand.
Deja Vu#070.dst: 시간 여행이 솔깃한 건 아네. 하지만 자네가 상상하는 것보다 훨씬 위험하지.
Deja Vu#070.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#071.src: The valley is banned for most citizens. I watch over this timeline because of poor souls like Asher.
Deja Vu#071.dst: 골짜기는 대부분의 주민에게 금지된 곳이네. Asher 같은 가엾은 이들 때문에 이 시간선을 지키지.
Deja Vu#071.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#075.src: How did you get these powers? Are you even human?
Deja Vu#075.dst: 그런 힘은 어떻게 얻었어요? 사람은 맞아요?
Deja Vu#075.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#076.src: Oh you know. I've read a book or two in my time.
Deja Vu#076.dst: 오, 뭐. 살면서 책 한두 권쯤은 읽었지.
Deja Vu#076.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#077.src: {u}, I'm sorry I got you dragged into this. I wish I could have done it myself.
Deja Vu#077.dst: {u}, 이 일에 끌어들여 미안하네. 내가 직접 할 수 있었으면 좋았을 텐데.
Deja Vu#077.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#078.src: I probably could have gotten myself out...
Deja Vu#078.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#079.src: You died in the past. Multiple times.
Deja Vu#079.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#081.src: Yes. In some surprising ways too.
Deja Vu#081.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#082.src: {u}, I'm sure we will meet again... in time.
Deja Vu#082.dst: {u}, 분명 다시 만날 걸세... 때가 되면.
Deja Vu#082.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#086.src: I don't understand Martyn. He seems to know everything about the past. Here, come closer, I want to whisper something.
Deja Vu#086.dst: Martyn은 도통 모르겠어. 과거 일을 전부 아는 것 같아. 이리 와 봐, 귓속말할 게 있어.
Deja Vu#086.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#088.src: I think he might have known Bob. I saw some letters in his house.
Deja Vu#088.dst: 그 사람 Bob을 알았던 것 같아. 집에서 편지를 몇 통 봤거든.
Deja Vu#088.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#089.src: Weird, right? Bob was a hard guy to know.
Deja Vu#089.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#090.src: Anyway, take this. It's the least I can do to pay you for saving me.
Deja Vu#090.dst: 아무튼 이거 받아. 날 구해 준 보답으로 이 정도는 해야지.
Deja Vu#090.speaker: Asher
